narrative.intro: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals has $279M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Regeneron Pharmaceuticals received 3 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $93.1M. Regeneron Pharmaceuticals' obligations show large swings across recent years: FY21 obligations were $5.6B, FY22 obligations were $494K, and FY23 obligations were $326M. The current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date, and award-value figures in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations. Stakeholders should note the concentration of FY2026 obligations into a small number of awards and the contrast between FY21 and the more recent years when reviewing Regeneron Pharmaceuticals' federal contracting activity.
